## Variables

### workspaceBuildPolicy

```ts
const workspaceBuildPolicy: "package-json-fungi-build-v2" =
  "package-json-fungi-build-v2";
```

The pinned workspace build policy: how a captured workspace's manifests build
(`package.json#fungi.build`). v2 lets a dependency name its own package build
script, which only an admitted Computer build runs.

It is part of every workspace HTML recipe's toolchain, so its digest moves with
it, and the Computer build request carries it at the top level, where a builder
compiled before it existed refuses the request outright.

---

### TEAM\_APP\_CANDIDATE\_MANIFEST\_MAX\_BYTES

```ts
const TEAM_APP_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES: number;
```

The largest candidate manifest request body, in bytes. A manifest names objects;
their bytes are uploaded one at a time, never inside it.

One content-addressed object a build uploaded before its manifest.

### candidateObjectMediaTypes

```ts
const candidateObjectMediaTypes: readonly [
  "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  "application/vnd.fungi.app-backend+json",
  "application/octet-stream",
];
```

The media type an uploaded object is stored with. A store that reads an HTML
document or backend descriptor by its stored type (the Publisher's) needs it; an
asset's type is its manifest's, so it is an octet stream.

## Functions

```ts
function contentObjectRef(digest): ArtifactRef;
```

The store key of one content-addressed object.

| Parameter | Type           |
| --------- | -------------- |
| `digest`  | `Sha256Digest` |

#### Returns

`ArtifactRef`

### putContentObject()

```ts
function putContentObject(
  bucket,
  object,
  body,
  mediaType,
): Promise<"refused" | "stored">;
```

Stream one object into the store under its digest. The store refuses a body
whose SHA-256 differs; an object already stored with the same verified digest
and size is kept (write-once: a stored version may be pinned by a Release) and
the body is discarded, never stored.

#### Parameters

| Parameter           | Type                                                                                                          |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bucket`            | [`ContentObjectBucket`](#contentobjectbucket)                                                                 |
| `object`            | \{ `digest`: `Sha256Digest`; `byteLength`: `number`; \}                                                       |
| `object.digest`     | `Sha256Digest`                                                                                                |
| `object.byteLength` | `number`                                                                                                      |
| `body`              | `ReadableStream`\<`Uint8Array`\<`ArrayBufferLike`\>\> \| `null`                                               |
| `mediaType`         | \| `"text/html; charset=utf-8"` \| `"application/vnd.fungi.app-backend+json"` \| `"application/octet-stream"` |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`"refused"` \| `"stored"`\>
